# `<util/arena.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Bump allocator over a caller-provided buffer.

Allocations only move a cursor forward; nothing is freed individually. ArenaReset() releases everything at once.

```c
#include <util/arena.h>
```

## Structures

### `Arena` { #arena }

An arena: a buffer and how much of it is used. The heap's reservation and current break.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `base` | `uint8_t *` | Start of the buffer. |
| `size` | `size_t` | Buffer size in bytes. |
| `offset` | `size_t` | Bytes handed out so far. |
| `base` | [`VirtAddr`](../../types.md#virtaddr) | Start of the reservation. |
| `brk` | [`VirtAddr`](../../types.md#virtaddr) | Current break. |
| `mapped` | [`VirtAddr`](../../types.md#virtaddr) | End of the reservation. |

## Functions

### `ArenaInit` { #arenainit }

```c
void ArenaInit(Arena *a, void *buf, size_t size);
```

Sets up an arena over `buf`.

The arena does not own the buffer.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | out | [Arena](#arena) to initialise. |
| `buf` | in | Backing buffer. |
| `size` | in | Size of `buf` in bytes. |

### `ArenaAlloc` { #arenaalloc }

```c
void * ArenaAlloc(Arena *a, size_t size);
```

Takes `size` bytes from the arena, with no alignment.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | inout | [Arena](#arena) to allocate from. |
| `size` | in | Bytes wanted. |

**Returns:** The memory, or NULL if fewer than `size` bytes are left.

### `ArenaAllocAligned` { #arenaallocaligned }

```c
void * ArenaAllocAligned(Arena *a, size_t size, size_t align);
```

Takes `size` bytes from the arena, aligned to `align`.

Skips padding bytes as needed to reach the alignment.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | inout | [Arena](#arena) to allocate from. |
| `size` | in | Bytes wanted. |
| `align` | in | Alignment in bytes; must be a power of two. |

**Returns:** The memory, or NULL if padding plus `size` does not fit.

### `ArenaReset` { #arenareset }

```c
void ArenaReset(Arena *a);
```

Releases every allocation at once; the buffer is kept for reuse.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | inout | [Arena](#arena) to reset. |

### `ArenaDestroy` { #arenadestroy }

```c
void ArenaDestroy(Arena *a);
```

Forgets the buffer and zeroes the arena.

The buffer itself is not freed.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | out | [Arena](#arena) to clear. |
